name: manual_671924
claim: Superseding or rendering a memory lesson is not a privacy scrub: sanitize the source JSONL/candidate/episodic row and every derived view, then run a strict .agent portable-brain scan covering exact local-only verboten literals, private/unclassified full emails, personal paths, workspace topology, local-temp paths, and secret patterns before commit.

decisions.notes: PR #260 follow-up: a superseded rendered lesson hid that the source memory row still carried private identity text. The durable fix is source scrubbing plus an executable .agent guard, not display-only supersession.
